opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
It is to be noted that under section 163A of the M.V. Act, the owner of the motor vehicle or the authorised ensurer shall be liable to pay in case of death or permanent disability due to accident arising out of the use of motor vehicle, compensation, as indicated in the Second Schedule, to the legal heirs or the victim, as the case may be, and the applicant shall not be required to plead or establish that the death or permanent disability in respect of which the claim has been made was due to any wrongful act or neglect or default of the owner of the vehicle or vehicles concerned or of any other person.
3. In the claim petition, the present appellant was the only respondent and as observed by the learned Tribunal, though notice was issued and served upon him, and sufficient opportunity was accorded to the opponent, and the Advocate to file written statement, they did not avail the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/1580/2023 ORDER DATED: 17/07/2023 undefined opportunity, and therefore, the right to file the written statement was ordered to be closed.
The proceedings suggest that the present appellant had not resisted the claim petition, and, therefore in view of the provisions of section 163A, this Court does not find any reason to entertain the present appeal;
hence, stands rejected.
